$comment: Z Clear — importer valuation-disagreement information flow. Synthetic sample only. The amount is what the importer typed on the case; Z Clear never assesses customs value, duty, VAT or fees. Customs value is decided in ASYCUDA World.

information.scope: Importer-only case lookup; another importer gets 404, agent staff get 403.

query.scope: Only the importer on the case can query a revision in review. The state change is audited and the agency receives an outbox event.

sampleInformationResponse.notice: This is the value recorded on your case, not a customs assessment. Z Clear does not decide customs value, assess duty or tax, or send anything to ZRA. Customs value is decided in ASYCUDA World.
